description.p: Unofficial fan-made Qt desktop client for Immich, a self-hosted photo and video management platform. Browse your library, explore people and places, upload and download media, and stream videos from your own server.
Features include an Immich-style timeline, explore views, search, upload queue with offline retry, local caching, themes, system tray, and single-instance desktop integration.
This project is not affiliated with, maintained by, or endorsed by the official Immich project.
